newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korean won ends lower on dollar short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Korean won ends lower on dollar short-covering.

text.p: The won closed lower against the dollar on Friday on dollar short-covering and some importer deals, dealers said.
The won closed at 824.60 after opening at 821.00.
Dealers said the won hit a day low of 825.30 on dollar short-covering due to lower-than-expected dollar sales from foreign stock funds.
"If the greenback rises further, short-covering will continue as there many shorts," said a local bank dealer.
Dealers said the won/dollar market would fluctuate in line with commercial deals and the movement of yen/dollars on the world market.
Monday's mid-rate was estimated to be fixed at 823.80 against 820.80 on Friday.
Dealers forecast the dollar would move in a 822-826 won range on Monday.
